picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's role leading 13 Genesis Mission projects and partnering on 30+ more makes it the single largest node in DOE's new national AI-for-science initiative, signaling where the government is concentrating its AI research investment.
picks.title: Berkeley Lab to Lead 13 New Genesis Mission AI Projects

picks.editorial_note: ORNL leading nine Genesis Mission projects and contributing to 32 others cements the national labs as the backbone of DOE's AI push, with scale rivaling Berkeley Lab's award.
picks.title: Department of Energy selects ORNL to lead nine Genesis Mission projects | ORNL

picks.editorial_note: NASA's entry into the Genesis Mission, alongside 15+ federal agencies under an executive order, shows the initiative expanding from a DOE program into a genuine whole-of-government AI strategy.
picks.title: NASA Joins Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI-Driven Discovery - NASA

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's award to lead six Genesis Mission projects and partner on 17 more further illustrates how concentrated DOE's AI-for-science funding is among a handful of national labs.
picks.title: Sandia selected to lead six Genesis Mission projects, partner on 17 others

picks.editorial_note: Penn State's $20M NSF award to lead a national 'programmable cloud laboratory' node represents a major infrastructure investment in autonomous, AI-driven experimentation distinct from the DOE Genesis Mission funding wave.
picks.title: Penn State awarded $20M to lead an NSF ‘programmable cloud laboratory’ | Penn State University

picks.editorial_note: Boston University's matching $20M NSF award for a biotech-focused cloud lab node shows the same national automated-science network taking shape across multiple institutions.
picks.title: NSF Awards Boston University $20 Million to Help Create National “Cloud Lab” Network

picks.editorial_note: Imperial's CuspAI reaching a £2 billion valuation after a £330 million raise is a rare example of academic AI materials research translating directly into a heavily-funded commercial venture.
picks.title: Imperial expert leads science at £2 billion AI materials company CuspAI

picks.editorial_note: EPFL, ETH Zurich, and CSCS's Apertus 1.5 release adds multimodal capability to one of the few fully open large language models trained at national-supercomputer scale, a notable counterpoint to closed frontier models.
picks.title: Apertus 1.5: Building the next generation of open AI infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: TUM and MIT's expanded AI and robotics partnership, backed by Bavarian government funding and reciprocal faculty exchanges, deepens a marquee transatlantic academic collaboration.
picks.title: TUM and MIT are expanding their strategic partnership in the fields of AI and robotics. The Bavarian Ministry of Science is providing 1.6 million.

picks.editorial_note: CMU, Pitt, and UW researchers' deep-learning discovery linking 3D genome architecture to Alzheimer's disease is a concrete scientific finding rather than a funding announcement, demonstrating AI's direct research payoff.
picks.title: AI, Single-Cell Technology Reveal How 3D Genome Differs in People With Alzheimer's Disease
